stories.title: Conga launches an MCP server to connect commercial data with AI assistants
stories.summary: WHAT HAPPENED: In its 14 October release, Conga announced a new Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets teams use Microsoft Copilot, Claude and other compatible assistants to retrieve Conga information such as contracts, quotes, obligations and approvals through natural language. Conga also says its AiMe offering now spans 90+ tools and 19 skills. STATUS: Confirmed vendor announcement; actual access may depend on product, configuration and customer permissions.
stories.why: MCP connectivity is becoming a practical bridge between AI assistants and business systems. For marketing and revenue operations, the opportunity is to query commercial context without manually switching between tools, while preserving permissions and approval controls.
stories.use_case: For a B2B team, prototype a read-only workflow that summarizes approved quote terms or flags missing contract approvals before a campaign or customer offer goes live. Keep write actions behind human approval.
stories.tool: Conga MCP Server; Conga AiMe; Microsoft Copilot; Claude; MCP-compatible assistants

stories.title: OpenAI reports rapid growth in agentic AI use among EU small businesses
stories.summary: WHAT HAPPENED: OpenAI published new Economic Research on 14 October examining agentic AI use across European enterprises and small businesses. It reports that agentic weekly active users in its EU SMB sample grew 8.1× since May, and that Codex and ChatGPT Work account for more than half of output tokens in its EU ChatGPT Enterprise sample. STATUS: Confirmed research published by OpenAI; these figures describe OpenAI’s observed sample and should not be treated as universal market-wide adoption rates.
stories.why: The findings suggest some businesses are moving from using AI only for answers toward delegating multi-step work. Marketers can use this as a signal to test bounded workflows, but should measure reliability and business outcomes rather than adoption alone.
stories.use_case: Choose one repeatable workflow—such as summarizing campaign reports, drafting a weekly performance narrative, or assembling a QA checklist. Define approved inputs, require source links, and keep budget changes, client communications and publishing behind human review.
stories.tool: OpenAI Economic Research; ChatGPT Enterprise; Codex; ChatGPT Work

stories.title: Publicis points to AI-powered marketing demand in its Q3 growth
stories.summary: WHAT HAPPENED: Reuters reported on 13 October that Publicis reaffirmed its full-year outlook after Q3 organic revenue grew 5%, above the company-provided 4.8% consensus. Publicis attributed growth in part to client demand for AI-powered marketing and its combination of consumer data with AI analytics. STATUS: Secondary reporting on company results and executive comments, not a new marketing-platform feature launch.
stories.why: The signal is commercial rather than technical: clients are paying for data-informed, AI-enabled campaign planning. Agencies should connect AI initiatives to measurable outcomes instead of presenting automation as a goal by itself.
stories.use_case: When proposing an AI workflow, document the baseline time or cost, the marketing decision it improves, the KPI expected to move, the data permissions required, and the human QA step. Review impact after a controlled pilot.
stories.tool: Publicis data and AI analytics approach; agency marketing operations

stories.title: Google's October Demand Gen Drop adds Data Strength Uplift metric
stories.summary: WHAT HAPPENED: Google announced its October Demand Gen updates on 13 October. Data Strength Uplift is launching in Google Ads to help advertisers understand conversion gains associated with their data setup. Google also announced that Data Manager is expanding to Display & Video 360 and Google Analytics, and that enhanced conversions will soon be available in those products. STATUS: Confirmed announcement from Google's official Ads & Commerce blog; rollout and availability may vary by feature.
stories.why: Demand Gen performance depends on the quality and completeness of conversion signals. The new metric can help teams investigate whether their measurement setup is contributing to campaign outcomes, while expanded data tools may simplify first-party data activation across Google's marketing stack.
stories.use_case: Review the Data Strength Uplift metric when it becomes available, audit Google tag and first-party data coverage, verify conversion actions and consent settings, and compare conversion volume and value before making budget or bidding changes. Treat Google's cited uplift figures as platform-reported averages, not a guaranteed result for every account.
stories.tool: Google Ads Demand Gen; Data Manager; Google Analytics; Display & Video 360; Google Tag Gateway

stories.title: Three distinct signals: system connectivity, real-world agent use, and commercial demand
stories.summary: Conga’s release is a product update: an MCP connection plus expanded AiMe tools. OpenAI’s publication is adoption research, not a new model or feature launch. Publicis coverage is an earnings and demand signal, not a platform announcement. These items are kept separate to avoid implying that they describe the same development.
stories.why: Marketers need to distinguish what can be implemented now from evidence about broader adoption and from business commentary.
stories.use_case: Classify each AI story as product availability, research, reported business result, or commentary. Record the release date, access requirements, evidence source, relevant KPI and next validation step before changing SOPs.
stories.tool: Editorial verification and AI workflow evaluation checklist
